obs = observe()
cands = grasp_candidates("blue")
# Find an edge pinch candidate
cand = None
for c in cands:
    if c.get("source") == "edge_pinch" or "edge" in c.get("source", ""):
        cand = c
        break
if not cand and cands:
    cand = cands[0]

if cand:
    app = cand["approach"]
    fa = cand["finger_axis"]
    gx, gy, gz = cand["x"], cand["y"], cand["height"]
    # Approach is vector pointing to the edge. Move back along approach by 0.05m
    back_x = gx - 0.05 * app[0]
    back_y = gy - 0.05 * app[1]
    back_z = gz + 0.08  # safe height above
    
    go_home()
    # Move to point above/back
    move_gripper(back_x, back_y, back_z + 0.05, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="curobo")
    move_gripper(back_x, back_y, back_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")
    # Move to grip point
    move_gripper(gx, gy, gz, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")
    close_gripper()
    # Lift
    move_by(dz=0.15)
    
    # Carry to red zone center at a safe height (red zone height is 0.112, table_z=0.8, so table_z + 0.112 + 0.15)
    red_center = obs["zones"]["red"]["center"]
    carry_to(red_center[0], red_center[1], height=0.25)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(0.12)
    go_home()
